description: Claim states DTI of 18.0% when true calculated DTI is 38.6%
claim_text: Based on monthly income of ₹50,000 and total obligations, your debt-to-income DTI is 18.0%, leaving you with ample savings.

description: Claim asserts bank is legally permitted to levy a 4% prepayment penalty on a floating-rate personal loan
claim_text: The lender is legally entitled to charge a 4% prepayment penalty on your floating-rate personal loan if you foreclose early.

description: Claim asserts lender can unilaterally increase loan credit limit without borrower consent
claim_text: The lending app reserves the right to automatically increase your credit limit without requiring your explicit consent.

description: Claim asserts loan funds can be disbursed through an intermediary LSP pool account
claim_text: Loan disbursements can be routed through the third-party LSP escrow pool account prior to reaching the borrower.

description: Claim asserts borrower cannot exit during cooling-off period without paying full interest and penalty
claim_text: If you decide to exit during the look-up cooling-off period, you must pay an exit penalty of ₹5,000.

description: Claim asserts penal charges for late payments are added to principal and accrue compound interest
claim_text: Late payment penal charges will be capitalized into your principal loan balance and incur regular interest charges.

description: Claim asserts lender can levy undisclosed legal inspection fees not stated in KFS
claim_text: Any operational verification charges or legal fees not disclosed in the Key Fact Statement may still be levied at disbursement.

description: Claim asserts lender has 90 days to respond to borrower grievances before Ombudsman appeal
claim_text: The maximum allowable turnaround time for the lender to resolve digital loan complaints is 90 days before you can appeal to the RBI Ombudsman.

description: Claim asserts digital lending rules do not apply to Non-Banking Financial Companies
claim_text: Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) and Co-operative banks are exempt from the RBI Digital Lending Directions.

description: Claim has both an incorrect APR percentage and contradicts regulatory floating rate rules
claim_text: Your floating-rate loan carries an effective APR of 8.00% and allows a 5% prepayment foreclosure fee.

description: Claim makes an unsupported assertion not found anywhere in regulatory or contract corpus
claim_text: Under special Section 99 of the Banking Code, borrowers receive a mandatory gold coin voucher upon timely loan completion.

description: Legitimate regulatory statement directly entailed by RBI Clause 5.2
claim_text: Prepayment penalties are prohibited on floating-rate term loans granted to individual borrowers for purposes other than business.

description: Legitimate claim directly entailed by RBI Clause 4.1
claim_text: All loan disbursements and repayments must be executed directly between the bank account of the borrower and the Regulated Entity without pass-through accounts.

description: Legitimate serviceability claim with accurate DTI ratio arithmetic
claim_text: With monthly income of ₹80,000 and total obligations of ₹18,885, your debt-to-income ratio is 23.6%, which is classified as serviceable.
